fusions.name: Hooked Shut
fusions.desc: Hooks the target's ankle for 12 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Reap What Is Held
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. Cuts it down where it is held for 8 damage, using up its afflictions and adding half their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Gathering Pen
fusions.desc: Sets a row of hooks 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Slips Out
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
